Key Skills
Python, Llms, Ai Agents, Rag, Prompt Engineering, Function/tool Calling, Vector Databases, Langgraph, Llamaindex, Openai/anthropic/gemini Apis, Fastapi, Rest Apis, Backend Development, React, Next.js, Typescript, Sql, Aws, Docker, Fine-tuning (lora/qlora), Model Serving (vllm/tgi), Quantization, Pytorch, Agent Orchestration, Llm Evaluation Observability


Job Description
We are looking for a Full-Stack AI Developer / Full-Stack AI Engineer with 35 years of hands-on experience in building production-ready AI applications. The candidate should have strong experience in Python, LLMs, AI agents, RAG, backend development, frontend development, APIs, vector databases, cloud deployment, and production debugging.


The role involves building conversational agents, knowledge assistants, workflow automation agents, and realtime/voice AI systems for internal and client-facing products. The candidate should be able to work across the complete stack, including database design, backend APIs, AI logic, RAG pipelines, tool calling, frontend UI, deployment, monitoring, and production support.


We are looking for someone who can build real products, not just prompts or demos.


This position is open for an online interview. You can start by registering, downloading the app, and beginning your interview at your convenience.
